research_question: Can we predict the next pandemic?
answer_frame: Forecast stage-specific risk and preparedness relevance rather than claim exact prediction of the next pandemic.

evidence_capsules.capsule: Use host/virus traits for surveillance prioritization, not exact time-and-place prediction.
Keep reservoir, exposure, spillover, and human infection layers distinguishable.
Evaluate the surveillance system and its decision use, not only model discrimination.
Use realistic temporal and geographic validation; inspect sampling and lineage effects.
Do not trade operational surveillance for a prediction narrative.

invariants: Every selected idea must cite at least one accepted GAP ID.
No selected idea may promise an exact future pandemic date, pathogen, or place.
Every proposal must specify falsification and abstention conditions.
No new observed result may be asserted.
